events.name: New York Mets at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Juan Soto's two-run single in the second inning gave New York the lead, Nolan McLean regrouped after a rough start and the Mets held off Atlanta's ninth-inning comeback attempt to...
headlines.shortLinkText: McLean regroups and Soto hits 2-run single as scuffling Mets barely hold off Braves 10-9

headlines.description: — Konnor Griffin had a tiebreaking two-run single in the eighth inning, leading the Pittsburgh Pirates over the Washington Nationals 11-5 on Sunday in a game in which he was also spectacular in the field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin's big day leads the Pirates to an 11-5 win over the Nationals

headlines.description: — Spencer Steer broke up a scoreless game with his 14th home run this season, Nick Lodolo pitched six scoreless innings, and the Cincinnati Reds beat the Baltimore Orioles 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steer homers and Lodolo shuts down Orioles, Reds win 3-2 to avoid sweep

events.name: Minnesota Twins at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Joe Ryan scattered three hits in seven scoreless innings and the Minnesota Twins won a series at Yankee Stadium for the first time since 2014 with a 6-1 victory that sent New York to its ninth loss in 10 games on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan allows three hits in seven innings as Twins beat skidding Yankees 6-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery hit a two-run homer and Kyle Teel and Tristan Peters added solo shots as the Chicago White Sox beat the Cleveland Guardians 7-6 on Sunday to split a four-game series between the AL Central's top teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colson Montgomery homers as White Sox outlast Guardians 7-6 to split AL Central showdown series

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Nico Hoerner drove in two runs, Pete Crow-Armstrong had two hits, and the Chicago Cubs rallied for four runs in the sixth inning against a sloppy St. Louis defense to top the Cardinals 6-4 on Sunday and avoid a series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cubs beat the Cardinals 6-4, scoring 4 runs in the sixth to avoid a series sweep

events.name: Philadelphia Phillies at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Salvador Perez drove in two runs, Luinder Avile went five innings, and the Kansas City Royals snapped a four-game losing streak with a 5-2 win over the Philadelphia Phillies on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Perez drives in 2 as the Royals beat the Phillies 5-2 to end a 4-game losing streak

headlines.description: — Riley Greene homered, tripled and drove in four runs for the Detroit Tigers in a 6-3 win over the Texas Rangers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Riley Greene homers and triples for 4 RBIs as Tigers top Rangers 6-3

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Christian Walker and Isaac Paredes hit solo home runs, and four pitchers combined on a four-hit shutout, and the Houston Astros beat the Tampa Bay Rays 2-0 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Walker and Paredes hit HRs, 4 pitchers combine for shutout as Astros beat Rays 2-0

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Kyle Karros hit a three-run homer to left field in the eighth inning to give the Colorado Rockies the lead in a 7-6 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Karros hits a 3-run homer in the 8th to lift the Rockies past the Giants, 7-6

headlines.description: — Jake Bauers homered off Arizona All-Star Eduardo Rodríguez in the seventh inning and the Milwaukee Brewers defeated the Diamondbacks 3-2 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bauers homers off Rodríguez in 7th, Brewers come back to beat Diamondbacks 3-2

headlines.description: — Eury Pérez pitched seven perfect innings before getting lifted by Miami manager Clayton McCullough, and the Marlins nearly squandered...
headlines.shortLinkText: Eury Pérez perfect for 7 innings, then Marlins hang on for 9-8 win over A's

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Seattle Mariners

headlines.description: — Emerson Hancock and the Mariners bullpen extended Seattle’s scoreless streak to 24 innings and Mitch Garver hit a two-run homer in a 4-0 win over the Toronto Blue Jays on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Emerson Hancock, Mariners blank Blue Jays 4-0; Mitch Garver hits a 2-run homer

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Manny Machado hit a three-run homer, Jackson Merrill and Fernando Tatis Jr. added RBI singles, and the San Diego Padres snapped their eight-game losing streak with a 5-2 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Padres snap their 8-game skid with 5-2 win over Dodgers on Manny Machado's 3-run homer

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Jarren Duran and Willson Contreras homered, and five Boston pitchers combined to give up two runs over 6 1/3 innings in relief of injured starter Ranger Suarez to lead the Red Sox to a 7-5 win over the Los Angeles Angels on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox ride homers by Duran and Contreras plus stout relief work to 7-5 win over Angels
